hypothesis_to_refute: H: every finite biplanar graph is 9-colourable
obstructions: O1 no uniform chi-raising biplanarity-preserving operation
O3 generalised Mycielskians M_r(G), r>=1, chi(G)>=9, never biplanar

e2.clauses: one per (C5 partition P of 5, placement phi: X->9 classes)
filters: edge count A∪B∪X' and A∪X' for every X' subset of X
post_filters_only: exact biplanarity decision for any model

controls.C1: no filters, t=1: exactly one model (x complete to seed)
controls.C2: k=8, seed K5 v C5, t=1: SAT, model gives K6 v C5
controls.C3: brute force 2^11 neighbourhoods, independent colouring routine

gate.PROGRESS: witness/candidate, or a surviving template with positive calibrated evidence and a concrete finite next step whose success refutes H
gate.PIVOT: otherwise, including negative template exclusions only
gate.pivot_recommendation: PAUSE or a named alternative with reason
